Triage Reference Guide
📋 Scenario Checklist & Guide (Expand)
⚡ Triage Principle:
• Indicators = Initial starting signals (Requires at least 1 Primary + 1 Secondary Indicator)
• Logs/Features = Supporting evidence
• Final Classification = Reached after deep digging across historical baselines & multi-step logs.

S1 — IP Theft via Media

👁️ View Description
User with no prior removable drive or after-hours activity starts logging in after hours, using a removable drive, and uploading data to wikileaks.org.
PRIMARY: Wikileaks Access Count
SECONDARY: After-Hours (Night and weekend), Thumb Drive Usage Count
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Correlate unusual timing, removable-media behavior, web activity, and prior baseline context.

S2 — Fraud via Job/USB

👁️ View Description
User searches job websites and solicits competitor employment. They heavily use a thumb drive to steal data, exceeding prior activity levels.
PRIMARY: Job Site Access Count
SECONDARY: Competitor Email Count, Thumb Drive Usage Count
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Compare removable-drive activity against historical baseline and correlate with competitor solicitation emails.

S3 — Misuse via Keylogger

👁️ View Description
Disgruntled administrator downloads a keylogger, transfers it via thumb drive to supervisor's machine, and uses keylogs to send mass email causing panic.
PRIMARY: Keylogger Download Count
SECONDARY: After-Hours (Night and weekend), Thumb Drive Usage Count
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Reconstruct multi-step sequence: device, malware/keylogger, supervisor machine access, mass email & timing.

S4 — Exfiltration

👁️ View Description
User logs into another user's machine, searches for files, and emails them to a personal account, with increasing frequency over 3 months.
PRIMARY: Unauthorized Login Count
SECONDARY: Home Email Count, File Search Count, Decoy File Access Count
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Examine cross-user machine access, file activity, decoy honey-pot access, personal email destination & longitudinal 3-month increase.

S5 — Mixed Profile

👁️ View Description
Multi-Vector Overlapping Activity Profile matching complex scenario combinations or data blending variations.
PRIMARY: Overlapping Spikes
SECONDARY: Multi-vector indicators
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Correlate multiple baseline drift trends across separate channels simultaneously.

S6 — Benign Anomaly

👁️ View Description
High statistical deviation triggered by legitimate workload spikes or temporary task shifts without malicious intent or exfiltration activity.
PRIMARY: Isolated Deviation
SECONDARY: Safe task spikes
🔍 Supporting Evidence: Verify absence of unauthorized logins, keyloggers, or leaks sites; confirm legitimate working hours.
